chunks.text: Leonardo Solé Rodrigues | Full Stack Engineer | Rio de Janeiro, Brazil | +55 21 99578-6916 | leosole@gmail.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/leosole | GitHub: github.com/leosole | Website: leosole-cv.netlify.app

Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years in production web and mobile applications, specialized in TypeScript, React, and Next.js. Before engineering, spent 5 years as an Art Director — which bridges design, marketing, user experience, and code in ways most engineers can't. Published researcher in multi-criteria navigation; undergraduate thesis in cross silo federated learning.

Tribunal de Contas da União (TCU) | Frontend Engineer | Nov 2024 – Present

Built internal content management systems, design systems, and portal modernization work for a public-sector organization using Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and the Unio Design System.

Unio Design System: Built the internal React/TypeScript design system from the ground up with polymorphic APIs and Storybook, reducing developer onboarding time through self-service component discovery.

Portal Modernization: Migrated the public portal from Lumis CMS to Next.js and Strapi, decoupling content management from the frontend to enable independent publishing by non-technical teams and improving LCP and TTFB via SSR and static generation.
CI/CD Infrastructure: Migrated 20+ pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, standardizing reusable workflows and reducing execution time by an estimated 20-30%.

Workflow Automation: Built a reusable GitHub Projects automation adopted across the team, consolidated separate discipline projects into one shared workflow, and automated task transitions based on pull request state and environment labels.

Trimble Inc. | Full Stack Engineer | Jul 2021 – Nov 2024

Worked across full-stack product delivery, microfrontend architecture, mobile app support, and production observability for enterprise fleet and telematics systems.

Microfrontend Architecture: Designed the Module Federation architecture for the Inspections portal within Trimble Fleet Manager, enabling autonomous CI/CD and independent PR workflows per team. The pattern became the internal standard for new product onboarding.

Trimble Inspections: Shipped the MVP to production, taking features from concept through phased rollout for major North American commercial fleets, and contributed to the Kotlin mobile app on the Trimble Instinct platform.
Technical Leadership: Delivered two internal Tech Talks on microfrontend architecture and mentored interns while migrating legacy C# ELD modules to React and TypeScript.

Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ) | Undergraduate Researcher | Jan 2020 – Nov 2022

Conducted machine learning research focused on federated learning and multi-criteria navigation systems with published results.

metadata.institution: Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ)

chunks.text: Federated Learning: Developed a method for cross-silo training where institutions hold datasets with partially overlapping variables. Implemented the solution in Python, TensorFlow, and Flower; the approach outperformed local models in heterogeneous data environments.
Multi-Criteria Navigation: Designed two route-planning algorithms (HVT and R2V) that factor in crime rates and road conditions alongside travel time.

Publication: Solé Rodrigues, L., et al. "Towards drivers' safety with multi-criteria car navigation systems." Future Generation Computer Systems, Vol. 135, 2022. Released a dataset of 3,170 paths across London.

metadata.title: Towards drivers' safety with multi-criteria car navigation systems
